technique_name: Generate a list of goals for this upcoming year.
description:
1. Take a class in a subject I'm interested in
2. Participate in at least one volunteer project
3. Improve my knowledge of a language
4. Reach a personal fitness goal
5. Reduce my carbon footprint
6. Read at least 12 books
7. Stop participating in hobbies that don't bring me joy
8. Develop a meditation practice
9. Spend quality time with family and friends
10. Take more trips to new places
11. Develop a side hustle
12. Come up with an idea for an invention
13. Create a blog or vlog about somethi
